profile.description: Bear Lake Harvest Festival is Sept. 19, 2026 from 12:00 PM-6:00 PM at the Bear Lake County Fairgrounds in Montpelier, Idaho. The Bear Lake County Chamber replied Sept. 2, 2026 that local attractions are already attending and the festival does not have funds for an attraction of this size. Treat 2026 as a budget and fit decline, not a permanent rejection. A reply draft is prepared offering a guaranteed-minimum/pay-for-play structure and asking when 2027 planning begins if this year is already set.

contacts.name: Bear Lake County Chamber of Commerce

notes.subject: 2026 verified — separate from Fall Market Days
notes.body: User supplied the current Bear Lake County Chamber events page. Verified Bear Lake Harvest Festival on Sept. 19, 2026, 12-6 PM, Bear Lake County Fairgrounds, Montpelier ID. Vendor application deadline was Aug. 31. Published booth options were 10x10, including powered booths, so direct contact was required to discuss the larger Adventure Zone footprint. Keep this separate from historical Bear Lake Fall Market Days in Garden City UT unless the organizer confirms continuity.

notes.subject: Sept. 2, 2026 reply — local attractions booked; budget objection
notes.body: Bear Lake County Chamber replied that local attractions are already attending and they do not have the funds to bring in an attraction of this size. Treat this as a 2026 budget/fit decline rather than a permanent rejection. Desiree prepared a reply draft offering a guaranteed-minimum arrangement with attendees paying to play, which would avoid the full attraction package cost upfront. The draft also asks when the Chamber begins planning for the next year's festival and when to contact them if 2026 is already set. The draft is unsent as of Sept. 2, 2026; update the follow-up timing after the Chamber answers.
